name: jenkins-tools
description: Jenkins MCP (the Jenkins MCP Server plugin) through mcp-remote: jobs, builds, logs. Running builds is blocked by the core guard, except non-production jobs for the devops role.

jenkins_mcp_url.title: Jenkins MCP URL
jenkins_mcp_url.description: The Jenkins MCP Server plugin endpoint, e.g. https://ci.example.com/mcp-server/mcp

jenkins_auth.title: Jenkins Authorization header
jenkins_auth.description: Basic <base64 user:apitoken>. Use a user WITHOUT build permission (devops: build rights on non-production jobs only).
